title: Funding Partnership Fit Map
placeholder: Click any need or approach to see what it covers.

nodes.label:
Ongoing Recurring
Support
detail: Money the club can count on term after term, rather than a one-off.

nodes.label:
One-Time Equipment
or Space
detail: A specific gap: ten laptops, a room for a showcase, a set of kits.
The only need here addressed by two different approaches.

nodes.label:
Access to a Grant
Requiring 501(c)(3)
detail: A funder that only gives to registered nonprofits, which most young clubs are not.

nodes.label:
Lower Cost on
Regular Purchases
detail: Not more money, but the same money going further on things bought repeatedly.

nodes.label:
Local Company
Partnership
detail: A business that supports the club regularly -- cash, equipment, or volunteer hours -- as part of its own community commitment.

nodes.label:
Strategic Partnership
Building
detail: A relationship with another organisation, such as a university club or library, where each side has something the other needs.

nodes.label:
Nonprofit Fiscal
Sponsorship
detail: An established nonprofit receives the grant on the club's behalf, so the club can apply without incorporating first.

nodes.label:
Vendor Discount
Negotiation
detail: Asking a supplier for an education or nonprofit rate on the things the club buys anyway.
